=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- tests/test_review_autofix_claude_fixer_mode.py:482 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: test_resolve_step_wiring still asserts on the old `pr_meta="$(gh_retry _safe_gh_jq "repos/${REPOSITORY}/pulls/${PR_NUMBER}" || echo 'null')"` string, but the PR changed the "Check PR state (defense-in-depth)" step in .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml (line 2458) to `gh_pr_cached_read pull`, and the fallback stub on line 2456 does not match either, so the test now fails.
  WHY: The test fails with an AssertionError. The pre-push gate lists the whole file as an "inherited failure", which hides the new failure, and the test stays red after the base-side failure is fixed (source severity MAJOR).
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:457-472 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The new `gh_pr_cached_read pull` branch (line 466) runs only when PR_PAYLOAD_FILE is more than 120 s old or the state can't be derived from it. The pull cache entry is written at the same time as that file and has the same 120 s TTL (`_gh_pr_cache_entry_fresh`: `[ "${age}" -lt 120 ]`), so the branch always misses and then makes a live read.
  WHY: This site saves no PAT calls toward the issue's 8–12 target. It still fails open correctly, but adds a stats "miss" line and an extra shell stage (all reviewers said NIT).
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:1567-1570,1723 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `_pr_base_sync_count` calls `gh_pr_cached_read issue_comments "${repo}" "${pr_number}"` with no head SHA, so it keys to `..._issue_comments_na.json`, while review_collect_pr_metadata.sh:232/233 keys to `..._issue_comments_<sha>.json`, and neither read can reuse the other. sonnet adds that the bare marker POST on line 1723 does not evict, so a second `_pr_base_sync_count` within 120 s can miss the newly posted marker.
  WHY: There are no savings at this site in the common path. In sonnet's second-call case, PR_BASE_SYNC_COUNT undercounts by one; that count only drives the max_syncs warning threshold and the marker sync number, so merge safety is not affected (all reviewers said NIT; minimax notes the author's comment at 1551-1553 calls this a design choice).
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:1217-1289 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `_gh_pr_cache_evict_match` waits at most 60 s for the lock (`flock -x -w 60 9 || true`, lines ~1281-1289), while a reader in `gh_pr_cached_read` can hold it for up to 300 s (`flock -x -w 300 9`, ~1217). After the eviction gives up and runs `rm -f`, the reader's later `mv -f "${fetched}" "${entry}"` (~1256-1260) puts back the payload it fetched before the PR write.
  WHY: SHA-keyed kinds (issue_comments, reviews, review_comments, files) have no TTL, so the stale entry is served as a hit for the rest of the job, which breaks the "every PR write in the job evicts the affected kinds" invariant. Severities disagree: minimax MAJOR, gemini and glm NIT; the highest is used. sonnet explicitly rejected this race: the store runs milliseconds after the successful gh call, so the stored data comes after the write.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:1245-1250 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: In the cache-hit / successful-write path, if `cat "${out}"` fails, the function returns the error code with no warning and empty stdout.
  WHY: Downstream readers such as review_collect_pr_metadata.sh parse the empty output as empty JSON, which can break downstream logic or cause silent fallbacks.
- agents.d/9928-review-pr-read-cache.md:"Merge invariant" bullet | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The fragment says "exactly one live `pulls/N` read precedes `gh pr merge --auto`", but scripts/review_enable_auto_merge.sh has two live reads in the merge path: line 119 in `reviewed_head_is_current_for_labels()` and line 242 at the top level. The new test `test_auto_merge_keeps_one_live_head_read_before_merge` allows both.
  WHY: The documentation is inconsistent with the code. Maintainers may miscount the merge path's live reads and later route a new read through the cache by mistake.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "codex-agent call sites read through it: … review_enable_auto_merge.sh:119 (reuse the cache) and :242"
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_enable_auto_merge.sh::reviewed_head_is_current_for_labels (line 119) and the top-level fetch at line 242
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The PR has no hunk in scripts/review_enable_auto_merge.sh, and lines 119 and 242 still make live `gh_retry gh api "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls/${PR_NUMBER}"` calls before the merges on lines 418 and 469. tests/test_gh_pr_cached_read.py::test_auto_merge_keeps_one_live_head_read_before_merge asserts that the script contains no `gh_pr_cached_read`. The plan grant's files_touched leaves this file out. The agents fragment's "Merge invariant" presents the deviation as deliberate, which contradicts the issue's call-site list. luna says line 242 may stay live but line 119 is not cached. Severities disagree: gemini and minimax MAJOR, sonnet and luna NIT.
- requirement: "Invalidation. Every PR write in the job evicts the affected kinds: push, label change, comment post, update-branch." and "A test lists every write helper the codex-agent job calls and asserts it evicts."
  expected_change_site: scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh::_pr_base_sync_marker_post (line 1723); scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh::review_prepush_test_gate_final_ci_marker (line 1237); tests/test_gh_pr_cached_read.py
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: Line 1723 runs a bare `_safe_gh_jq -X POST "repos/${repo}/issues/${pr_number}/comments"` and line 1237 runs a bare `gh api -X POST "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/issues/${PR_NUMBER}/comments"`. Neither calls `gh_pr_cache_evict`. `_safe_gh_jq` (scripts/gh_helpers.sh:2687) has no eviction hook; only gh_retry, gh_retry_to_file and gh_api_retry are hooked (scripts/gh_helpers.sh:2369, 2502, 2612). `test_every_retry_wrapper_evicts_after_its_command` checks only those three wrapper bodies. Both writers run in the codex-agent job (review_autofix.yml:3633/4042 and the merge path, reached from review_rb_judge.sh at review_autofix.yml:4904 and via `_pr_base_fresh_for_merge`, scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:1864) after Collect PR metadata has filled the cache. The update-branch PUT at line 1505 goes through gh_retry and does evict, which hides the gap on the current merge path. The agents fragment admits that bare writes do not evict. glm: a later cached issue_comments read can miss the new comment for up to 120 s and undercount merge-base-sync markers. minimax filed the two sites as separate gaps. Severities disagree: gemini, minimax and glm MAJOR; sonnet and luna NIT.
- requirement: "A cache write failure means a live call, with no error surfaced."
  expected_change_site: tests/test_gh_pr_cached_read.py
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: `test_cache_unavailable_falls_back_to_live_reads` covers only setup failures: the kill switch off, RUNNER_TEMP being a file, unusable or missing RUNNER_TEMP. `test_failed_live_fetch_returns_1_with_no_stdout_and_caches_nothing` covers a failed live fetch. No test makes the store fail (mktemp, `mv -f "${fetched}" "${entry}"`, or the metadata write) after cache setup succeeds, so the `fetched=""` and failed-`mv` branches of gh_pr_cached_read are untested.
- requirement: "other kinds are keyed by head SHA" and each PR resource is fetched once per head SHA.
  expected_change_site: scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh::_pr_base_sync_count
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: `review_collect_pr_metadata.sh` calls `gh_pr_cached_read issue_comments` with `pr_cache_head_sha` at line 233, but `_pr_base_sync_count` calls it without a SHA at `scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:1568`. The keys differ (`<sha>` versus `na`), so the merge-path comments read cannot reuse the entry already fetched for that head.
- requirement: "A run-local cache helper ... for kinds `pull`, `issue_comments`, `reviews`, `review_comments`, `files` and `check_runs`", with the issue's read-site list including `collect_pr_check_runs_context.py:176` and `pr_checks_lib.sh:706`.
  expected_change_site: scripts/collect_pr_check_runs_context.py:176 and scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:706
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: `gh_pr_cached_read` supports the `check_runs` kind, but no caller is converted to use it. Both sites still call `gh_retry gh api --paginate "/repos/{repo}/commits/{sha}/check-runs?per_page=100"` directly, so the `check_runs` kind ships unused. sonnet and glm explicitly did not count these as gaps, because the issue lists them under Context, not Goals.
- requirement: Issue body "### codex-agent call sites read through it: ... review_enable_auto_merge.sh:119 (reuse the cache) and :242", against the fragment's "Merge invariant: ... exactly one live `pulls/N` read precedes `gh pr merge --auto`".
  expected_change_site: agents.d/9928-review-pr-read-cache.md ("Merge invariant" bullet)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: scripts/review_enable_auto_merge.sh has two live `gh_retry gh api "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls/${PR_NUMBER}"` reads, at line 119 (reviewed_head_is_current_for_labels) and line 242 (the orchestrator-metadata fetch), and tests/test_gh_pr_cached_read.py::test_auto_merge_keeps_one_live_head_read_before_merge counts both. The fragment's "exactly one" claim contradicts the code whenever line 119 runs before the merge.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

The test was not updated, although the plan grant covers tests/**.

  WHY: The branch always misses and makes a live read, saving no PAT calls. It still fails open correctly and only adds a stats "miss" line.
